title: Add definitions to bird watching dictionary
goal: Use dl, dt, and dd to pair each term with its explanation.
summary: dl is a description list that can be used to compile dictionaries. dt marks the term, followed by dd giving the corresponding explanation.
tasks: Change the two paragraphs of text under the title to a dl description list.
The first group uses dt to write "wingspan", and then uses dd to write "The distance between the wing tips on both sides when the wings are unfolded."
The second group uses dt to write "resident bird", and then uses dd to write "A bird that stays in the same area year-round."

example.code:
<dl>
  <dt>Wake up noodles</dt>
  <dd>Let the mixed dough rest for a while.</dd>
</dl>
example.note: This baking dictionary follows "Wake up noodles" with its explanation.

hint: When the interpretation is misplaced, check whether each dd follows the corresponding dt. Putting all the terms together at the front will mess up the pairing.
